sources: Stone's August 23 to 28 plan (Preseason Game 4_ HC.md): the first-quarter lineup (the current chart's starting points, determined after Detroit with no job awarded: Monroe, Bitonio, Brewster, Turner, Johnson; Jones-Drew; Nicks, Thielen, Adams; Lewis, Kelce in the twelve-personnel packages; Cousins; the starting defense with Mincey at Edge 1, Daryl Smith the communicator and Poyer at the nickel), the second-quarter developmental line (Leno, Norwell, Linsley, Feiler, Lucas), the quarterback order (Cousins, Henne, Wilson, Shaw; Bray without a block) and the medical decisions (Jackson out; Brate out; Jensen on the independent medical hold through the freeze; Poyer cleared August 26 by the record's method); the working depth chart (career/2014/00_Team_Operations/Team/Depth_Chart/working_depth_chart.json) for the rest; the camp record through August 27 for the players added but not placed, in the order of their recorded use; the current roster for control and availability.
rule: Order within each kernel position group, first = starter, as the kernel reads it. Stone's plan sets the lineups by quarter through rotation.json, whose blocks lead their groups on the field; this order is a game-depth order for this preseason game only. Johnson is fifth among the linemen, the first-quarter right tackle as the current chart's starting point, with Lucas sixth as the developmental line's right tackle from the second quarter on and Leno seventh as its left tackle; nothing here awards a place. Mincey stays first among the defensive linemen as the carried Edge 1 starting point and opens the starting defense; Cain stays first among the snappers as the carried place, and Kreiter opens the operation by the rotation's block, neither a promotion. Poyer is fifth among the defensive backs, the nickel, after his August 26 clearance. Jensen, Jackson and Brate are listed last in their groups and inactive. The tight-end and reserve orders list the players in the order the camp record uses them and award no place; TE3 and the reserve corner remain open.

game_day_inactives.note: Preseason dresses the whole roster. Bradfield, Clemons, Brown and Pasztor are carried on the 78-player controlled roster on unsigned tenders, are not under contract, have not reported and may not practice or play until they sign: inactive by contract status, not by a medical instruction; they did not count against the August 26 limit of 75, which was met at 74 with no transaction. Jerrell Jackson: out under the August 14 instruction (lower extremity, multi-week; projected return October 9, 2014; reassessed August 21 with no change; no further reassessment date), inactive by medical instruction; roster disposition pending. Cameron Brate: out, long term, under the August 8 instruction (projected return January 15, 2015; reassessed August 15 with no change), inactive by medical instruction and out of the plan; roster disposition pending. Marcel Jensen: independent medical hold from the August 22 game (head/neck, minor; reassessed August 24 with no change; projected return August 28, game day); on the hold at the August 27 freeze and absent from the week's work, so inactive by the plan's own rule (the names frozen after the medical review; no building around an unavailable player); a release on August 28, if the independent process communicates it, is recorded on the day and does not reopen the frozen plan. Jordan Poyer: out from August 22, reassessed August 23 with no change, cleared August 26 on his projected date by the record's method; took part normally August 26 and 27 and is active at the nickel. Lane Johnson, Richard Murphy, C.J. Anderson and Cornelius Lucas worked every session with no communicated limitation and are active. No other player is under a communicated medical instruction; August 23 to 27 communicated no injury or restriction. James Hurst is held on the undrafted board pending a medical clearance and is not a controlled player, so he cannot appear here.
